About me
Ed Donner is a coder, speaker and leader in the field of Agentic Al, Forward Deployed
Engineering and LLMs. He's the co-founder and CTO of Al startup Nebula, a former
Managing Director at JPMorgan Chase, and a well-regarded lecturer on LLMs and
Agents with over a million enrollments across 194 countries. He previously founded Al
startup untapt, acquired in 2021, after a 15 year career in technology on Wall street. He
holds a patent in a deep learning matching model, and an MA in Physics from Oxford.
When he's not at work experimenting with LLMs, Ed can usually be found at home..
